dependency_setup_policy.historical_policy: Choose a small date-bucket profile from task_time. Prefer editable installs for 2024+ and 2022-2023 tasks; use older Python and capped pytest/docutils/setuptools constraints for pre-2022 tasks. Try at most three profiles per task, stop on first reference pass, and label dependency mismatch rather than solving arbitrary environments.

historical_verifier_profiles.why_selected: Sphinx 8-era commits with modern pyproject metadata and pytest 8 support.
Sphinx 5-7-era commits before the Python 3.12 floor.
Older Sphinx commits where pytest, setuptools, Jinja2, and docutils caps are the likely replay boundary.

dependency_setup_policy.raw_artifact_policy: Do not commit raw stdout, stderr, workspaces, prompts, completions, or transcripts; record only command shapes, counters, durations, labels, and tail hashes.

known_environment_risks: Modern Sphinx requires Python >=3.12; historical tasks may require older Python profiles.
Some tests use doc build fixtures and optional parser/builder dependencies; changed-test certification must stay on narrow pytest shards.
Docutils, pytest, setuptools, and importlib metadata compatibility changes are likely historical replay failure sources.
Graphviz, image, linkcheck, JavaScript, or external-network tests are not supported in this no-paid prep gate.
unsupported_assumptions: This profile does not make full-suite Sphinx verification a requirement.
This profile does not certify tasks whose only oracle is documentation output without narrow changed tests.
This profile does not authorize paid Agent cells, paid LLM calls, tuner calls, baseline discovery, or before/after tuning experiments.
This profile is not a general historical Python environment solver.
